rationale: Independent judgment: APPROVE. R57 is a narrow, correctly diagnosed mechanical repair of the retention-timer serialization that caused R56's partial install to stop. (1) Root cause confirmed by evidence, not just claimed: R56_INSTALL.stderr shows `systemctl enable --now ...retention.timer` failing with "Bad message"; R56_PARTIAL_INSTALL_RECONCILIATION.stdout shows the installed timer text containing literal backslash-n ("[Unit]\\nDescription=...") with UnitFileState=bad/LoadState=error, complete_exists=false, and all three R56 units inactive. (2) The fix is correct: scope.diff removes the old `'\\n...'.encode()` literal and introduces retention_units() building the timer via chr(10).join([...]) (real newlines), and the new test asserts bytes([92,110]) (literal \\n) is absent and the exact line structure/cleanup target. (3) The fix adds verify_units(), which writes rendered units to a temp dir and runs `systemd-analyze verify`, failing closed with RENDERED_UNIT_INVALID; crucially install() calls verify_units at line 113 BEFORE the first production put() at line 117, so a malformed unit is caught before any production write — a strengthened, not weakened, safeguard. (4) Native host evidence (NATIVE_PARSER.stdout) shows the corrected units pass verify (exit 0) while the literal-\\n negative control fails (exit 1). (5) Immutable-successor safety preserved: CHANGE rename yields fresh ROOT/RECORD/UNIT paths, EXISTS_RECONCILE requires none pre-exist, and PRIOR_ACTIVE requires the R56 main unit be inactive/failed (it is). The failed R56 roots/units/review/charge are retained. (6) No accounting/privacy/budget change: caps 75/1200/1275 unchanged, no amounts/refusals altered, no credentials, no patient-derived publication, cleanup_package remains self-gating and member-only. Diff is exactly the 7 in-scope files (85/17), commit aef08563 equals the bound source_sha. This fits the operator's verbatim engineering-judgment and mechanical-repair standing rules (no hard line crossed), so no separate user approval is required for the review itself. Findings are empty.
